approval_source.question_set: Which runs the campaign's performance KPIs are read from

reason: The campaign.performance KPIs (block interval percentiles, inclusion within 2 blocks, response time) are defined outside injected faults, and the results collector had no summarizer for them.

decisions.question: Which runs count for the performance KPIs
decisions.rule: The performance KPIs are read from the load runs' evidence (load.py run) only, so every sample is outside injected faults.
